parName: # here are standard input for forest resources. Region can be a level1 or overriden at level 2. Values can be time independent ot time dependent
# vol is the volumes, as exogenously read, in one specific class
# betaCoef is the Volume gain ratio from current diam class to next one
# mortCoef is the mortality coefficient within a given class
# tp is the time of passage [years] from a diameter class to go to the next one.
# vReg is the (exogenous) regeneration for the first class
# entryVolHa(i,essence,lambda) initial density at the beginning of the first diameter class, when trees reach 7.5 cm [m^3/ha].
# hv2ha -  is the harvested volumes to free area - [1/m] (opposite of Vol/ha from IFN data)
